name: Compass-HR-AI-Module
headline: Compass-HR: AI Module for Workforce Development
short_description: Compass-HR is an AI-driven module that enhances HR capabilities by analyzing career paths, identifying skill gaps, and mapping organizational competencies. It provides tailored learning plans, team-building insights, and strategic alignment for workforce development, leveraging Russian labor market data.
author: TheAndreyZakharov

sections.overview:
Compass-HR-AI-Module is an AI-driven HR solution designed to strengthen human resources operations through intelligent analysis of career trajectories and organizational competencies. The module identifies skill gaps within teams, generates tailored learning development plans, and provides team-building insights to align workforce capabilities with strategic objectives. It leverages Russian labor market data to inform HR decisions and supports data-driven workforce development strategies.
Identifying skill gaps in teams
Recommending personalized learning plans
Modeling future roles based on market trends
Estimating hiring costs for new positions
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the career paths of employees at [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector using Russian labor market data. Identify skill gaps and map organizational competencies. Provide tailored learning plans and team-building insights to align with strategic workforce development goals.
```
